definitions.gloss: in unison, with one voice, unanimously
definitions.explanation: Everyone saying the same thing, expressing the same opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}した→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
{異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: They all said "wonderful" with one voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The participants unanimously expressed their dissatisfaction.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) meaning 'with one voice' or 'unanimously.'

ETYMOLOGY:
{異口|いく} (different mouths) + {同音|どうおん} (same sound) — many people with different mouths all saying the same thing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: unanimously, with one voice (adverbial use)
- {異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say with one voice
- {異口同音|いくどうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}する→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧: to unanimously agree

USAGE:
Somewhat literary/formal. Used in writing and formal speech more than casual conversation. Emphasizes that multiple people independently expressed the same opinion or reaction.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えて→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: in unison (more everyday)
- ⟦{満場一致|まんじょういっち}→満場一致：28977_manjouicchi⟧: unanimous (formal, used for votes/decisions)
